bashCommands: find . -type f -not -path './.gradle/*' -not -path './build/*' | head -50 && cat build.gradle* settings.gradle* 2>/dev/null; for f in $(find src -name '*.java'); do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done

f=src/test/java/surveycrawler/SurveyCrawlerTest.java && python3 - "$f" <<'EOF'
import sys
p=sys.argv[1]; s=open(p).read()
for a,b in [('crawler.process("h1");','crawler.process("h0");'),
            ('crawler.process("(a(3")','crawler.process("(a33)")'),
            ('boulderAt(new Point(3, 2)));\n\n        assertThrowsWithDescription(crawler.boulderFoundErrorDescription(), () -> crawler.process("(ahtgaha0)"));','boulderAt(new Point(3, 4)));\n\n        assertThrowsWithDescription(crawler.boulderFoundErrorDescription(), () -> crawler.process("(ahtgaha0)"));'),
            ('assertTrue(crawler.isAtFacing(new Point(-3, 5), "Right"));','assertTrue(crawler.isAtFacing(new Point(3, -1), "Right"));')]:
    assert s.count(a)==1, a
    s=s.replace(a,b)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
gradle test 2>&1 | grep -E "FAILED|tests completed|BUILD"; ls build/test-results/test/ && grep -o 'tests="[0-9]*" skipped="[0-9]*" failures="[0-9]*" errors="[0-9]*"' build/test-results/test/*.xml
